Location.Address: International Coastal Road, next to Delta University for Science and Technology, Gamasa, Dakahlia Governorate, 7730203, Egypt

General_Info.School_Type: Public Boarding High School for Outstanding Students
General_Info.Infrastructure_Details: State-of-the-art physics, chemistry, biology, and FabLabs, student dormitories, dining halls, and multi-purpose sports courts next to Delta University.

Funding_And_Projects.Name: USAID STEM Teacher Education and School Strengthening Activity (STESSA)
Funding_And_Projects.Funding_Body: USAID (United States Agency for International Development)
Funding_And_Projects.Description: Funding for curriculum development, IT laboratories, teacher professional training, and Capstone research mentorship programs to strengthen the STEM school network in Egypt, including the Dakahlia campus.

Funding_And_Projects.Name: Electronics Research Institute Robotics and AI Capacity Building Program
Funding_And_Projects.Funding_Body: Electronics Research Institute (ERI) / Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
Funding_And_Projects.Amount: In-kind Technical Support & Specialized Training Labs
Funding_And_Projects.Description: Practical training labs, robotics summer school bootcamps, and qualifying competitions organized by ERI to train Dakahlia STEM students in robotics, IoT, and embedded systems.

Funding_And_Projects.Name: Mansoura University Scientific Capstone Research Support Initiative
Funding_And_Projects.Funding_Body: Mansoura University (Faculty of Agriculture and Faculty of Science)
Funding_And_Projects.Description: Institutional collaboration providing students of Dakahlia STEM School free access to university scientific laboratories, research guidance, and raw materials for their semester Capstone projects.

Funding_And_Projects.Name: Sawiris Foundation Onsi Sawiris Scholarship Award
Funding_And_Projects.Funding_Body: Sawiris Foundation for Social Development / Orascom Construction
Funding_And_Projects.Description: Full undergraduate study scholarship in the United States awarded to outstanding graduate Yumna Bakr, class of 2025, for bachelor studies in engineering.

Funding_And_Projects.Name: ASRT International Competition Finalist Sponsorship (Regeneron ISEF)
Funding_And_Projects.Funding_Body: Academy of Scientific Research and Technology (ASRT) / Ministry of Education
Funding_And_Projects.Description: Financial sponsorship and research incubation for Dakahlia STEM student Mariam Al-Senbati to participate in the international Regeneron ISEF 2026 science fair in the USA, where she won 4th place globally for her environmental innovation.
